{{small|(19 April 2026)}} | prevseason = [[2025 Uzbekistan Super League|2025]] | nextseason = [[2027 Uzbekistan Super League|2027]] | updated = 19 April 2026 }} The '''2026 Uzbekistan Super League''' ({{langx|uz|Футбол бўйича 2026–йилги Ўзбекистон Суперлигаси}}) is the 35rd season of top-level football in [[Uzbekistan]] since its establishment in 1992. ==Season events== On August 21, 2025, the [[President of Uzbekistan]] adopted a resolution "On measures to digitalize and popularize the football industry in Uzbekistan". It outlined such objectives as increasing the number of people regularly involved in football, recruiting talented players and supporting Uzbek footballers playing professional football abroad. Beginning March 1, 2026, it was announced that purchasers would be identified when selling tickets to football matches.{{Cite web |title=Endi futbol o‘yinlariga chipta olish uchun shaxsni tasdiqlash talab etiladi |url=https://qalampir.uz/uz/news/endi-futbol-uyinlariga-chipta-olish-uchun-shakhsni-tasdik-lash-talab-etiladi-123284}}{{Cite web |title=ПҚ-262 23.08.2025 Ўзбекистонда футбол соҳасини рақамлаштириш ва оммавийлигини янада ошириш чора-тадбирлари тўғрисида |url=https://lex.uz/pdfs/7696588 |access-date=2026-04-16 |website=lex.uz}}{{Cite web |title=1-martdan futbol o‘yinlariga chipta sotishda xaridorlar identifikatsiyadan o‘tkaziladi |url=https://www.gazeta.uz/oz/2025/08/25/football/}} The current season saw an expansion from 16 teams. At the end of the [[2025 Uzbekistan Super League|previous season]], [[FC Shurtan Guzar|Shurtan]] were relegated to the [[2026 Uzbekistan Pro League|Pro League]]. The newly promoted teams from the [[2025 Uzbekistan Pro League|lower division]] were [[Lokomotiv Tashkent|Lokomotiv]].{{cite web |title=2023 season fixtures released: Uzbekistan Super League to start on 3 March |url=https://www.pfl.uz/ru/m/news/view/15090 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240604103623/https://pfl.uz/ru/m/news/view/15090 |url-status=dead |archive-date=June 4, 2024 |website=pfl.uz/ |publisher=Uzbekistan Professional Football League |access-date=28 February 2023 }} On February 12, [[Uzbekneftegaz]] announced in a letter sent to [[Uzbekistan Football Association]] that it would stop funding the [[FC Nasaf|Nasaf]], [[FC Bukhara|Bukhara]] and [[FC Bunyodkor|Bunyodkor]] clubs starting in 2026.{{Cite web |title=«O‘zbekneftgaz» futbol klublariga homiylik qilishni to‘xtatadi |url=https://kun.uz/73328500 |website=Kun.uz |access-date=2026-02-28 |language=uz |last=kunu.uz}}{{Cite web |title=“O‘zbekneftgaz” “Nasaf”, “Buxoro” hamda “Bunyodkor” klublarini moliyalashtirishni to‘xtatdi |url=https://daryo.uz/2026/02/12/ozbekneftgaz-nasaf-buxoro-hamda-bunyodkor-klublarini-moliyalashtirishni-toxtatdi/ |website=Daryo |date=2026-02-12 |access-date=2026-02-28 |language=uz-Latn-UZ |first= |last=}}{{Cite web |title=O‘zbek futbolida davlat homiyligi davri tugamoqdami |url=https://uz.kursiv.media/uz/2026-02-26/ozbek-futbolida-davlat-homiyligi-davri-tugamoqdami-ozbekneftgaz-qarori-ortidagi-haqiqatlar/ |website=Kursiv Media Uzbekistan - Kursiv Media Uzbekistan – O'zbekiston iqtisodiyoti va siyosati, biznes va moliya yangiliklari |date=2026-02-26 |access-date=2026-02-28 |language=uz |first=Sardor |last=Saidov}} On February 25, [[Yandex|Yandex Uzbekistan]] and the [[Uzbekistan Professional Football League|League]] signed a strategic partnership agreement aimed at expanding digital opportunities for fans. As part of the agreement, Yandex Uzbekistan became the official partner of Super League and the title sponsor of Pro League.{{cite web|url=https://championat.uz/oz/news/rasman-yandex-uzbekistan-pro-liganing-titul-homiysi|title=Yandex Uzbekistan va PFL hamkorligi: Allplay va Kinopoisk platformalarida o'yinlarni translyaciya qilish to'g'risida kelishuv}}{{cite web|url=https://www.gazeta.uz/oz/2026/02/26/pfl-vs-yandex/|title=PFL Yandex Uzbekistan bilan hamkorlik boshladi: Superliga o‘yinlari Kinopoisk va Allplay`da, Yandex Proliga titul homiysi bo‘ldi}}{{cite web|url=https://sports.uz/oz/news/view/yandex-uzbekistan-proliganing-rasmiy-titul-homiysiga-aylanadi-25-02-2026|title=“Yandex Uzbekistan” Proliganing rasmiy titul homiyiga aylanadi}} The first goal of the season was scored by [[FC Bukhara|Bukhara]] forwarder [[Sherzod Esanov]] against [[Kokand 1912]].{{Cite web |title=Superliga. "Buxoro" – "Qo'qon-1912" 1:0 |url=https://championat.asia/oz/news/superliga-buxoro-qoqon-1912-10 |access-date=2026-02-28 |website=CHAMPIONAT.asia |language=uz}} In order to improve the financing of professional football clubs, it is planned that by 2026 each Super League club will receive an annual budget of 35 billion soums (2892000 USD) from the state.{{Cite web |date=2026-03-26 |title=O‘zbekistonda 2026-yilda futbol klublariga 35 mlrd so‘mdan ajratiladi |url=https://daryo.uz/2026/03/26/ozbekistonda-2026-yilda-futbol-klublariga-35-mlrd-somdan-ajratiladi/ |access-date=2026-04-16 |website=Daryo |language=uz-Latn-UZ}}{{Cite web |title= PQ-107-сон 24.03.2026. Sport sohasini moliyalashtirish mexanizmlarini takomillashtirish va sohaga tadbirkorlik subyektlarini jalb qilishni kengaytirish chora-tadbirlari toʻgʻrisida |url=https://lex.uz/en/docs/-8097905 |access-date=2026-04-16 |website=lex.uz}} [[FC AGMK|AGMK]] played its home matches at the [[Olympic City Stadium|Olympic Stadium]] until the 8th round due to the unfinished reconstruction of its [[AGMK Stadium|home stadium]].{{Cite web |title=OKMK o‘z stadioniga qaytmoqda, So‘g‘diyona mavsumning qolgan uy uchrashuvlarini Zominda qabul qiladi - PFL.UZ |url=https://pfl.uz/news/okmk-oz-stadioniga-qaytmoqda-sogdiyona-mavsumning-qolgan-uy-uchrashuvlarini-zominda-qabul-qiladi |access-date=2026-04-16 |website=pfl.uz}} Matches, which were suspended in early May due to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup|World Cup]], returned on July 20.{{Cite web |title=Superliga-2026. Taqvim rejasi klublar bilan kelishildi - PFL.UZ |url=https://pfl.uz/news/superliga-2026-taqvim-rejasi-klublar-bilan-kelishildi |access-date=2026-09-04 |website=pfl.uz}} ==Teams== {{Location map+|Uzbekistan|width=600|float=right|caption=|places={{Location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=41.31379 |long=69.26743 |label='''Tashkent''' |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=40.84531 |long=69.59999 |label= [[FC AGMK|AGMK]]}} {{Location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=40.86670 |long=72.77836 |label= [[FC Andijon|Andijan]]|position=right}} {{location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=39.46198 |long=64.24468 |label= [[FC Bukhara|Bukhara]]|position=left}} {{location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=39.88236 |long=66.80039 |label= [[FC Dinamo Samarqand|Dinamo]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=38.83824 |long=65.81386 |label= [[FC Nasaf|Nasaf]]}} {{Location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=40.99963 |long=71.59382 |label= [[PFC Navbahor Namangan|Navbahor]] |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=40.386389 |long=71.786389 |label= [[FC Neftchi Fergana|Neftchi]]|position=right}} {{location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=39.67057 |long=65.10812 |label= [[Qizilqum FC|Qizilqum]]|position=bottom}} {{location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=40.11404 |long=67.82897 |label= [[FC Sogdiana|Sogdiana]]|position=top}} {{Location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=37.216667 |long=67.283333 |label= [[FC Surkhon|Surkhon]]|position=top}} {{location map~ |Uzbekistan |lat=41.560778 |long=60.593037 |label= [[FC Khorazm|Khorazm]]|position=left}} {{Location map~ |Uzbekistan |mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png |lat=40 |long=56 |label=Tashkent teams
